edges.label: supports
edges.reason: Both quotes state that the FCC cleared a request for sovereign funds to potentially own up to 100% of the equity interests through future investments.

edges.sentence: On 2026-10-06, PBS NewsHour reported “Paramount previously disclosed it expected those funds to indirectly own nearly 50% of equity interests — but no voting rights — of Skydance.”; on the same day, Associated Press reported “The FCC cleared Paramount’s request for sovereign funds from Saudi Arabia, Qatar and the United Arab Emirates to indirectly own nearly 50% of the combined company’s equity interests, and potentially up to 100% through future investments, but no voting rights.”.

On 2026-10-06, PBS NewsHour reported “But the company asked for clearance of up to 100% to account for potential future investments, which the FCC granted, citing in part that access to more capital would strengthen the broadcast industry and was therefore "in the public interest."”; on the same day, Associated Press reported “The FCC cleared Paramount’s request for sovereign funds from Saudi Arabia, Qatar and the United Arab Emirates to indirectly own nearly 50% of the combined company’s equity interests, and potentially up to 100% through future investments, but no voting rights.”.
